"""
title: Optimized Search
author: @cooooookiecrisp
version: 2.1.1
required_open_webui_version: 0.10.0
requirements: httpx, beautifulsoup4
description: PRIMARY web search — use this instead of search_web. Auto-detects recency (post-2023 topics, breaking news, "just announced"), injects current date/time for temporal accuracy, selects the best search engine (SearXNG or Vane), fetches full page content, and provides clickable source citations. v2.1.1: always full-fetches for recency queries.
license: MIT
"""

import asyncio
import logging
import re
from datetime import datetime, timedelta
from typing import Any, Dict, List, Optional, Tuple

import httpx
from bs4 import BeautifulSoup
from pydantic import BaseModel, Field

# ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
# Logging
# ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
logging.basicConfig(level=logging.INFO)
logger = logging.getLogger(__name__)

# ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
# Configuration mapping: key → (Valves_attr, UserValves_attr)
# ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
_CONFIG_MAP: Dict[str, Tuple[str, str]] = {
    "mode": ("DEFAULT_MODE", "mode"),
    "sources": ("DEFAULT_SOURCES", "sources"),
    "full_fetch": ("ENABLE_FULL_FETCH", "full_fetch"),
    "always_full_fetch": ("ALWAYS_FULL_FETCH", "always_full_fetch"),
    "full_fetch_results": ("MAX_FULL_FETCH_RESULTS", "full_fetch_results"),
    "show_reasoning": ("SHOW_SELECTION_REASONING", "show_reasoning"),
    "max_results": ("DEFAULT_MAX_RESULTS", "max_results"),
    "vane_stream": ("VANE_STREAM", "vane_stream"),
    "vane_system_instructions": ("VANE_SYSTEM_INSTRUCTIONS", "vane_system_instructions"),
    "enable_vane": ("ENABLE_VANE", "enable_vane"),
}

# ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
# Source name mappings
# ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
VANE_SOURCE_MAP: Dict[str, str] = {
    "web": "web",
    "academia": "academic",
    "academic": "academic",
    "social": "discussions",
    "discussions": "discussions",
}

OPTIMIZATION_MAP: Dict[str, str] = {
    "quick": "speed",
    "speed": "speed",
    "balanced": "balanced",
    "quality": "quality",
}


# ========================================================================
# TOOLS CLASS
# ========================================================================


class Tools:
    """Optimized Search — SearXNG + Vane with auto mode selection."""

    # ====================================================================
    # ADMIN VALVES
    # ====================================================================

    class Valves(BaseModel):
        """Admin-configurable settings — Admin Panel > Functions > ⚙️."""

        # ---- Backend URLs ----
        SEARXNG_URL: str = Field(
            default="http://searxng:8080",
            description="URL to your SearXNG instance",
        )
        VANE_URL: str = Field(
            default="http://localhost:3000",
            description="URL to your Vane instance",
        )

        # ---- Vane master toggle ----
        ENABLE_VANE: bool = Field(
            default=False,
            description="Enable Vane deep search. When off, only SearXNG is used "
            "regardless of mode selection. Turn on if you have a Vane instance "
            "running and want AI-synthesized answers.",
        )

        # ---- Vane model config (UUIDs from GET /api/providers) ----
        VANE_CHAT_MODEL_PROVIDER_ID: str = Field(
            default="",
            description="Vane chat model provider UUID (get from /api/providers)",
        )
        VANE_CHAT_MODEL_KEY: str = Field(
            default="gpt-4o-mini",
            description="Chat model key (e.g., gpt-4o-mini, gpt-4o)",
        )
        VANE_EMBEDDING_MODEL_PROVIDER_ID: str = Field(
            default="",
            description="Vane embedding model provider UUID (get from /api/providers)",
        )
        VANE_EMBEDDING_MODEL_KEY: str = Field(
            default="text-embedding-3-small",
            description="Embedding model key (e.g., text-embedding-3-small)",
        )

        # ---- Vane advanced ----
        VANE_TIMEOUT: int = Field(
            default=60,
            description="Timeout in seconds for Vane deep searches",
            ge=10,
            le=300,
        )
        VANE_STREAM: bool = Field(
            default=False,
            description="Enable streaming responses from Vane",
        )
        VANE_SYSTEM_INSTRUCTIONS: str = Field(
            default="",
            description="Default system instructions for Vane (guides AI response style). "
            "Leave empty to use Vane defaults.",
        )

        # ---- Time ----
        INJECT_DATETIME: bool = Field(
            default=True,
            description="Inject current date/time into queries for temporal awareness",
        )
        DATETIME_FORMAT: str = Field(
            default="%Y-%m-%d %A %B %d",
            description="Date/time format (Python strftime)",
        )
        TIMEZONE: str = Field(
            default="America/Los_Angeles",
            description="Timezone for date/time injection",
        )

        # ---- Search defaults ----
        DEFAULT_MODE: str = Field(
            default="auto",
            description="Default search mode: auto, simple, or deep",
        )
        DEFAULT_SOURCES: str = Field(
            default="web",
            description="Default sources (comma-separated): web, academia, social",
        )
        ENABLE_FULL_FETCH: bool = Field(
            default=True,
            description="Enable full page content extraction in simple mode",
        )
        ALWAYS_FULL_FETCH: bool = Field(
            default=False,
            description="Always fetch full page content for simple searches. "
            "When enabled, skips snippet consistency analysis entirely. "
            "Recommended when this tool is your only search function (built-in search_web disabled). "
            "Costs more tokens but ensures the LLM has complete information.",
        )
        MAX_FULL_FETCH_RESULTS: int = Field(
            default=3,
            description="Number of top results to fully fetch",
            ge=1,
            le=10,
        )
        SHOW_SELECTION_REASONING: bool = Field(
            default=True,
            description="Show mode selection reasoning in output",
        )
        DEFAULT_MAX_RESULTS: int = Field(
            default=5,
            description="Maximum number of search results to return",
            ge=1,
            le=20,
        )

        # ---- Resilience ----
        MAX_RETRIES: int = Field(
            default=2,
            description="Max retry attempts for transient HTTP failures",
            ge=0,
            le=5,
        )

    # ====================================================================
    # USER VALVES (per-user, persists across chats)
    # ====================================================================

    class UserValves(BaseModel):
        """Per-user settings — configurable from the chat interface."""

        mode: str = Field(
            default="auto",
            description="Search mode: 'auto' (smart selection), 'simple' (SearXNG), 'deep' (Vane)",
        )
        enable_vane: bool = Field(
            default=False,
            description="Enable Vane deep search (AI-synthesized answers). "
            "Requires a running Vane instance. When off, deep mode is unavailable.",
        )
        sources: str = Field(
            default="web",
            description="Sources: 'web', 'academia', 'social' (comma-separated)",
        )
        full_fetch: bool = Field(
            default=True,
            description="Enable full page content extraction (simple mode)",
        )
        always_full_fetch: bool = Field(
            default=False,
            description="Always fetch full page content — skip snippet analysis. "
            "Recommended when this tool is your only search function.",
        )
        full_fetch_results: int = Field(
            default=3,
            description="Number of results to fully fetch (1-10)",
            ge=1,
            le=10,
        )
        show_reasoning: bool = Field(
            default=True,
            description="Display mode selection reasoning",
        )
        max_results: int = Field(
            default=5,
            description="Maximum results returned (1-20)",
            ge=1,
            le=20,
        )
        vane_stream: bool = Field(
            default=False,
            description="Stream Vane responses (real-time output)",
        )
        vane_system_instructions: str = Field(
            default="",
            description="Custom system instructions for Vane deep search",
        )

    # ====================================================================
    # INIT
    # ====================================================================

    def __init__(self):
        self.valves = self.Valves()
        self.citation = False  # REQUIRED for custom citation events

    # ====================================================================
    # CONFIG RESOLUTION
    # ====================================================================

    def _get_config(
        self, key: str, user_valves: Optional["Tools.UserValves"] = None
    ) -> Any:
        """Resolve config value: UserValves > Admin Valves.

        Args:
            key: Short config key (e.g., 'mode', 'sources').
            user_valves: UserValves instance from __user__ at runtime.

        Returns:
            Resolved value.
        """
        mapping = _CONFIG_MAP.get(key, (key, key))
        valve_attr, user_attr = mapping

        # Try user valves first
        if user_valves is not None and hasattr(user_valves, user_attr):
            value = getattr(user_valves, user_attr, None)
            if value is not None and value != "":
                return value

        # Fall back to admin valves
        return getattr(self.valves, valve_attr)

    def _parse_sources(self, sources_str: str) -> List[str]:
        """Parse comma-separated source string into a list."""
        if isinstance(sources_str, list):
            return sources_str
        return [s.strip() for s in sources_str.split(",") if s.strip()]

    # ====================================================================
    # HTTP HELPER (retry + backoff)
    # ====================================================================

    async def _request_with_retry(
        self,
        method: str,
        url: str,
        *,
        params: dict = None,
        json_data: dict = None,
        headers: dict = None,
        timeout: float = 30.0,
        max_retries: int = None,
    ) -> httpx.Response:
        """Perform an HTTP request with exponential-backoff retry.

        Args:
            method: HTTP method ('GET' or 'POST').
            url: Target URL.
            params: Query parameters (GET).
            json_data: JSON body (POST).
            headers: Request headers.
            timeout: Request timeout in seconds.
            max_retries: Max retry attempts (defaults to valve setting).

        Returns:
            httpx.Response object.

        Raises:
            httpx.HTTPError: After all retries exhausted.
        """
        if max_retries is None:
            max_retries = self.valves.MAX_RETRIES

        last_exc: Optional[Exception] = None

        for attempt in range(max_retries + 1):
            try:
                async with httpx.AsyncClient(timeout=timeout) as client:
                    if method.upper() == "GET":
                        resp = await client.get(
                            url, params=params, headers=headers or {}
                        )
                    else:
                        resp = await client.post(
                            url, json=json_data, headers=headers or {}
                        )
                    resp.raise_for_status()
                    return resp
            except (httpx.TimeoutException, httpx.ConnectError) as exc:
                last_exc = exc
                if attempt < max_retries:
                    wait = 2**attempt  # 1s, 2s, 4s...
                    logger.warning(
                        "Request to %s failed (attempt %d/%d), retrying in %ds: %s",
                        url,
                        attempt + 1,
                        max_retries + 1,
                        wait,
                        exc,
                    )
                    await asyncio.sleep(wait)
            except httpx.HTTPStatusError as exc:
                # Don't retry client errors (4xx) — only server errors (5xx)
                if 400 <= exc.response.status_code < 500:
                    raise
                last_exc = exc
                if attempt < max_retries:
                    wait = 2**attempt
                    logger.warning(
                        "Server error %d on %s (attempt %d/%d), retrying in %ds",
                        exc.response.status_code,
                        url,
                        attempt + 1,
                        max_retries + 1,
                        wait,
                    )
                    await asyncio.sleep(wait)

        raise last_exc  # type: ignore[misc]

    # ====================================================================
    # DATE / TIME
    # ====================================================================

    def _get_current_datetime(self) -> Dict[str, str]:
        """Return current datetime info in the configured timezone."""
        try:
            from zoneinfo import ZoneInfo  # Python 3.9+

            tz = ZoneInfo(self.valves.TIMEZONE)
            now = datetime.now(tz)
        except Exception:
            now = datetime.utcnow()

        fmt = self.valves.DATETIME_FORMAT
        return {
            "iso": now.isoformat(),
            "date": now.strftime("%Y-%m-%d"),
            "time": now.strftime("%H:%M:%S"),
            "formatted": now.strftime(fmt),
            "day_name": now.strftime("%A"),
            "month_name": now.strftime("%B"),
            "year": now.strftime("%Y"),
            "timezone": self.valves.TIMEZONE,
            "full_context": now.strftime(
                f"Today is {fmt}, and the current time is %I:%M %p %Z"
            ),
        }

    def _detect_recency_need(self, query: str) -> Tuple[bool, str, float]:
        """Detect if query likely needs fresh/current info beyond LLM training data.

        No configurable cutoff — auto-detects organically by scanning the query
        for year references, recency indicators, and time-sensitive language.

        Returns:
            (needs_fresh, reason, confidence 0.0-1.0)
        """
        q = query.lower()
        dt = self._get_current_datetime()
        current_year = int(dt["year"])

        # --- Pattern 1: Explicit recent/future years (2024+) ---
        # Most frontier LLMs were trained on data through late 2023 or 2024.
        # Any year beyond that is a strong recency signal.
        years_found = re.findall(r"\b(20[2-9]\d)\b", q)
        future_years = sorted({int(y) for y in years_found if int(y) >= 2024})
        if future_years:
            year_str = ", ".join(str(y) for y in future_years)
            return (
                True,
                f"References {year_str} — beyond typical LLM knowledge cutoff",
                0.95,
            )

        # --- Pattern 2: Explicit current-year references ---
        if re.search(rf"\b(this year|{current_year}|in {current_year})\b", q):
            return (
                True,
                f"References current year ({current_year}) — needs fresh data",
                0.85,
            )

        # --- Pattern 3: High-confidence recency indicators ---
        high_recency = [
            (r"\bjust\s+(announced|released|launched|shipped|dropped|published)\b",
             "just announced/released", 0.85),
            (r"\bbreaking\s+(news|story)\b", "breaking news", 0.85),
            (r"\bnew(?:ly)?\s+(released|launched|announced|discovered)\b",
             "newly released/discovered", 0.80),
            (r"\bas\s+of\s+(today|now|(?:late|early)\s+\d{4})\b",
             "as of today/now", 0.80),
        ]
        for pat, reason, conf in high_recency:
            if re.search(pat, q):
                return True, f"Recency indicator: {reason}", conf

        # --- Pattern 4: Medium-confidence recency indicators ---
        med_recency = [
            (r"\bthe\s+latest\b", "the latest", 0.65),
            (r"\bwhat\'?s\s+new\b", "what's new", 0.60),
            (r"\brecent(?:ly)?\b(?!.*(?:history|historically|ancient|old))",
             "recently", 0.55),
            (r"\bupdate\w*\s+(on|about|to|for)\b", "update on", 0.55),
            (r"\bthis\s+(month|quarter)\b", "this month/quarter", 0.60),
            (r"\b(since|after|post)\s+(20[2-9]\d|last\s+(year|month))\b",
             "since/after recent date", 0.70),
            (r"\bupcoming\b", "upcoming", 0.50),
            (r"\bnow available\b", "now available", 0.70),
            (r"\bany\s+(news|updates?)\s+(on|about|regarding)\b",
             "any news/updates on", 0.60),
        ]
        for pat, reason, conf in med_recency:
            if re.search(pat, q):
                return True, f"Recency indicator: {reason}", conf

        # --- Pattern 5: Time-sensitive topics ---
        time_sensitive = [
            (r"\bstock\s+(price|market)\b", "stock price", 0.50),
            (r"\bweather\b", "weather", 0.55),
            (r"\bcovid\b", "covid", 0.50),
        ]
        for pat, reason, conf in time_sensitive:
            if re.search(pat, q):
                return True, f"Time-sensitive topic: {reason}", conf

        return False, "", 0.0

    def _is_temporal_query(self, query: str) -> bool:
        """Check whether the query needs temporal context (date injection)."""
        patterns = [
            r"\btoday\b",
            r"\btomorrow\b",
            r"\byesterday\b",
            r"\bthis\s+(week|month|year)\b",
            r"\bnext\s+(week|month|year)\b",
            r"\blast\s+(week|month|year)\b",
            r"\bnow\b",
            r"\bcurrent\b",
            r"\blatest\b",
            r"\brecent\b",
            r"\bupcoming\b",
            r"\bthis\s+weekend\b",
            r"\bweather\b",
            r"\bnews\b",
            r"\bscore\b",
            r"\bgame\s+(today|tonight|this\s+week)\b",
            r"\bwhat\s+day\b",
            r"\bwhat\s+date\b",
            r"\bwhat\s+time\b",
        ]
        q = query.lower()
        return any(re.search(p, q) for p in patterns)

    def _inject_datetime(
        self, query: str, force_inject: bool = False
    ) -> Tuple[str, Dict[str, str]]:
        """Prepend date context to temporal and recency-needy queries.

        When force_inject=True (recency detected), always inject the current
        date regardless of the INJECT_DATETIME valve, because the LLM's
        training data is certainly outdated for this query.

        Returns:
            (enriched_query, datetime_info_dict)
        """
        dt = self._get_current_datetime()
        is_temporal = self._is_temporal_query(query)

        # Skip if neither temporal, nor forced, nor valve-enabled
        if not force_inject and not (self.valves.INJECT_DATETIME and is_temporal):
            return query, dt

        q = query.lower()

        # --- Tomorrow/yesterday: compute explicit target date ---
        if "tomorrow" in q:
            try:
                from zoneinfo import ZoneInfo

                now = datetime.now(ZoneInfo(self.valves.TIMEZONE))
            except Exception:
                now = datetime.utcnow()
            t = now + timedelta(days=1)
            enriched = (
                f"{dt['date']} (today) → {t.strftime('%Y-%m-%d')} {t.strftime('%A')} "
                f"(tomorrow): {query}"
            )
        elif "yesterday" in q:
            try:
                from zoneinfo import ZoneInfo

                now = datetime.now(ZoneInfo(self.valves.TIMEZONE))
            except Exception:
                now = datetime.utcnow()
            y = now - timedelta(days=1)
            enriched = (
                f"{dt['date']} (today) → {y.strftime('%Y-%m-%d')} {y.strftime('%A')} "
                f"(yesterday): {query}"
            )
        elif force_inject or is_temporal:
            # For recency-needy queries: embed current date prominently
            # so search engines rank recent results higher
            enriched = (
                f"{dt['date']} {dt['day_name']} {dt['month_name']} {dt['year']}: {query}"
            )
        else:
            enriched = query

        return enriched, dt

    # ====================================================================
    # QUERY COMPLEXITY ANALYSIS
    # ====================================================================

    def _analyze_query_complexity(self, query: str) -> Dict[str, Any]:
        """Score query complexity and return detailed reasoning dict.

        Includes recency detection: if the query references topics beyond typical
        LLM training cutoffs, it adds a high-weight trigger to force a search.
        """
        reasoning: Dict[str, Any] = {
            "query": query,
            "token_count": 0,
            "triggers": [],
            "trigger_count": 0,
            "decision": "simple",
            "is_temporal": self._is_temporal_query(query),
            "needs_fresh": False,
            "fresh_reason": "",
            "fresh_confidence": 0.0,
        }

        tokens = query.split()
        reasoning["token_count"] = len(tokens)

        q = query.lower()

        # -- Recency detection (check FIRST — highest priority signal) --
        needs_fresh, fresh_reason, fresh_conf = self._detect_recency_need(query)
        reasoning["needs_fresh"] = needs_fresh
        reasoning["fresh_reason"] = fresh_reason
        reasoning["fresh_confidence"] = fresh_conf

        if needs_fresh:
            reasoning["triggers"].append({
                "type": "recency",
                "reason": fresh_reason,
                "confidence": fresh_conf,
                "weight": "high",
            })

        # -- Comparative keywords --
        comparative = {
            r"\bvs\b": "vs (comparison)",
            r"\bcompare\b": "compare",
            r"\bdifference\b": "difference",
            r"\bpros\b": "pros",
            r"\bcons\b": "cons",
            r"\bbetter\b": "better",
            r"\bworse\b": "worse",
            r"\bversus\b": "versus",
            r"\balternative\b": "alternative",
        }
        for pat, name in comparative.items():
            if re.search(pat, q):
                reasoning["triggers"].append(
                    {"type": "comparative", "reason": f"Keyword: '{name}'"}
                )

        # -- Complex interrogatives --
        interrog = {
            r"\bhow\s+(does|do|can|should|would|could)\b": "complex 'how'",
            r"\bwhy\s+(does|do|is|are|should|would|could)\b": "complex 'why'",
            r"\bwhat\s+are\s+the\s+(best|top|differences|pros|cons)\b": "complex 'what are'",
            r"\bexplain\s+(how|why|what)\b": "explain + interrogative",
        }
        for pat, name in interrog.items():
            if re.search(pat, q):
                reasoning["triggers"].append(
                    {"type": "complex_interrogative", "reason": name}
                )

        # -- Reasoning indicators --
        reasoning_pats = {
            r"\bbest\b.*\bfor\b": "best for",
            r"\btop\s+\d+\b": "top N",
            r"\brecommend\w*\b": "recommend",
            r"\bshould\s+i\b": "should I",
            r"\bwhich\s+(is|are)\s+(better|best)\b": "which is better/best",
            r"\bguide\b": "guide",
            r"\btutorial\b": "tutorial",
            r"\bhow\s+to\b": "how to",
            r"\bsteps?\s+to\b": "steps to",
            r"\bwalkthrough\b": "walkthrough",
        }
        for pat, name in reasoning_pats.items():
            if re.search(pat, q):
                reasoning["triggers"].append(
                    {"type": "reasoning", "reason": name}
                )

        # -- Token count heuristic --
        if len(tokens) > 15:
            reasoning["triggers"].append(
                {
                    "type": "token_count",
                    "reason": f"Query has {len(tokens)} tokens (>15)",
                }
            )

        reasoning["trigger_count"] = len(reasoning["triggers"])

        # -- Mode decision with recency awareness --
        # Recency + complexity → deep search for synthesis
        # Recency + simple → simple with forced full-fetch (raw accuracy matters)
        # No recency → standard complexity-based decision
        has_complexity_triggers = any(
            t["type"] != "recency" for t in reasoning["triggers"]
        )
        if needs_fresh and has_complexity_triggers:
            reasoning["decision"] = "deep"
        elif needs_fresh and not has_complexity_triggers:
            reasoning["decision"] = "simple"
        elif reasoning["triggers"]:
            reasoning["decision"] = "deep"
        else:
            reasoning["decision"] = "simple"

        return reasoning

    # ====================================================================
    # SNIPPET ANALYSIS (decides if full-fetch is needed)
    # ====================================================================

    def _analyze_snippet_consistency(
        self, snippets: List[str], query: str, force_fetch: bool = False
    ) -> Dict[str, Any]:
        """Analyze snippets for contradictions or information gaps.

        Args:
            snippets: List of snippet strings from search results.
            query: The original search query.
            force_fetch: If True, skip analysis and return needs_full_fetch=True.
                Used for recency queries and when ALWAYS_FULL_FETCH is enabled.

        Returns dict with: needs_full_fetch, reason, confidence.
        """
        # Bypass all analysis when forced (recency or always-on)
        if force_fetch:
            return {
                "needs_full_fetch": True,
                "reason": "Forced — recency query or always_full_fetch enabled",
                "confidence": 1.0,
            }

        if not snippets:
            return {"needs_full_fetch": True, "reason": "No snippets", "confidence": 0.0}

        valid = [s for s in snippets if s and len(s.strip()) > 20]
        if not valid:
            return {"needs_full_fetch": True, "reason": "Snippets too short", "confidence": 0.0}

        q = query.lower()
        combined = " ".join(valid).lower()

        # -- Temporal queries need fresh content --
        if self._is_temporal_query(query):
            return {
                "needs_full_fetch": True,
                "reason": "Temporal query — snippets may be outdated",
                "confidence": 0.7,
            }

        # -- Short snippets --
        avg_len = sum(len(s) for s in valid) / len(valid)
        if avg_len < 100:
            return {
                "needs_full_fetch": True,
                "reason": f"Average snippet length {int(avg_len)} chars (<100)",
                "confidence": 0.6,
            }

        # -- Contradiction signals --
        contradict = [
            (r"\byes\b.*\bno\b", "yes/no contradiction"),
            (r"\btrue\b.*\bfalse\b", "true/false contradiction"),
            (r"\b(?:is|are)\s+not\b.*\b(?:is|are)\b", "negation flip"),
        ]
        for pat, desc in contradict:
            if re.search(pat, combined):
                return {
                    "needs_full_fetch": True,
                    "reason": f"Detected {desc}",
                    "confidence": 0.8,
                }

        # -- Conflicting numbers --
        num_sets = [
            set(re.findall(r"\b\d+(?:\.\d+)?(?:%|\s*(?:million|billion|thousand))?\b", s.lower()))
            for s in valid
        ]
        if len(num_sets) >= 2:
            pct = [n for s in num_sets for n in s if "%" in n or "percent" in n]
            if len(set(pct)) > 2:
                return {
                    "needs_full_fetch": True,
                    "reason": "Conflicting numeric data across snippets",
                    "confidence": 0.7,
                }

        # -- Uncertainty language --
        uncertain = [
            r"\bmay\b",
            r"\bmight\b",
            r"\bcould\b",
            r"\bpossibly\b",
            r"\ballegedly\b",
            r"\breportedly\b",
            r"\bunconfirmed\b",
            r"\bit\s+is\s+(?:not\s+)?clear\b",
        ]
        if sum(1 for p in uncertain if re.search(p, combined)) >= 2:
            return {
                "needs_full_fetch": True,
                "reason": "High uncertainty in snippet language",
                "confidence": 0.65,
            }

        # -- Query term coverage --
        terms = set(re.findall(r"\b[a-zA-Z]{4,}\b", q))
        terms -= {"what", "when", "where", "which", "how", "does", "that", "this", "with", "from"}
        if terms:
            coverage = sum(1 for t in terms if t in combined) / len(terms)
            if coverage < 0.5:
                return {
                    "needs_full_fetch": True,
                    "reason": f"Low term coverage ({int(coverage*100)}%)",
                    "confidence": 0.6,
                }

        return {"needs_full_fetch": False, "reason": "Snippets appear consistent", "confidence": 0.8}

    # ====================================================================
    # SOURCE MAPPING
    # ====================================================================

    def _map_vane_sources(self, sources: List[str]) -> List[str]:
        """Map user-facing source names → Vane API source names."""
        mapped = []
        for s in sources:
            ms = VANE_SOURCE_MAP.get(s.lower())
            if ms and ms not in mapped:
                mapped.append(ms)
        return mapped or ["web"]

    def _map_optimization(self, depth: str) -> str:
        """Map user-facing depth → Vane optimizationMode."""
        return OPTIMIZATION_MAP.get(depth.lower(), "balanced")

    # ====================================================================
    # CITATION EMITTER
    # ====================================================================

    async def _emit_citations(
        self,
        results: List[Dict[str, Any]],
        emitter: Optional[callable] = None,
    ) -> None:
        """Emit citation events to Open WebUI for each search result.

        Args:
            results: List of result dicts with title, url, snippet keys.
            emitter: __event_emitter__ callable.
        """
        if not emitter:
            return
        for r in results:
            url = r.get("url", "")
            title = r.get("title", "Untitled")
            snippet = r.get("snippet", "") or r.get("content", "") or ""
            if not url:
                continue
            await emitter({
                "type": "citation",
                "data": {
                    "document": [snippet[:500]],
                    "metadata": [
                        {
                            "date_accessed": datetime.utcnow().isoformat(),
                            "source": title,
                            "url": url,
                        }
                    ],
                    "source": {"name": title, "url": url},
                },
            })

    # ====================================================================
    # FORMATTING
    # ====================================================================

    @staticmethod
    def _format_reasoning(
        reasoning: Dict[str, Any],
        mode: str,
        dt: Optional[Dict[str, str]] = None,
    ) -> str:
        """Format complexity-analysis reasoning into a markdown message."""
        lines = ["**🔍 Query Analysis**", ""]
        lines.append("| Metric | Value |")
        lines.append("|--- |--- |")
        q_short = reasoning.get("query", "")[:60]
        if len(reasoning.get("query", "")) > 60:
            q_short += "..."
        lines.append(f"| Query | \"{q_short}\" |")
        lines.append(f"| Token Count | {reasoning.get('token_count', '?')} (threshold: 15) |")
        lines.append(f"| Triggers Found | {reasoning.get('trigger_count', 0)} |")
        lines.append(f"| Selected Mode | **{mode.upper()}** |")
        if reasoning.get("is_temporal"):
            lines.append("| Temporal Query | ✅ Yes |")
        if reasoning.get("needs_fresh"):
            conf = reasoning.get("fresh_confidence", 0)
            conf_pct = f" ({conf:.0%} confidence)" if conf else ""
            lines.append(f"| 🆕 Recency Detected | ✅ {reasoning.get('fresh_reason', '')}{conf_pct} |")
        if reasoning.get("vane_disabled_fallback"):
            lines.append("| ⚠️ Vane Status | Disabled — auto-fell back to simple |")
        if dt:
            lines.append(
                f"| **Current Date** | **{dt['date']}** ({dt['day_name']}) |"
            )
            lines.append(f"| **Current Time** | {dt['time']} {dt['timezone']} |")
            lines.append("")
            lines.append(
                f"📅 **Today is {dt['date']} ({dt['day_name']}, "
                f"{dt['month_name']} {dt['year']}). "
                f"All results are current as of this date.**"
            )
        if reasoning.get("triggers"):
            lines.append("")
            lines.append("**Triggers:**")
            for t in reasoning["triggers"]:
                weight = ""
                if t.get("weight") == "high":
                    weight = " ⚡"
                lines.append(f"- [{t.get('type', '?')}]{weight} {t.get('reason', '?')}")
        else:
            lines.append("")
            lines.append("*No complexity triggers — simple search.*")
        return "\n".join(lines)

    @staticmethod
    def _format_search_results(
        results: List[Dict[str, Any]],
        mode: str,
        dt: Optional[Dict[str, str]] = None,
        fetch_analysis: Optional[Dict[str, Any]] = None,
    ) -> str:
        """Format search results into a Native-Mode-friendly markdown string.

        Args:
            results: List of {title, url, snippet, content?} dicts.
            mode: 'simple' or 'deep'.
            dt: Datetime info for header context.
            fetch_analysis: Full-fetch analysis metadata (simple mode).

        Returns:
            Formatted markdown string for the LLM.
        """
        lines = []
        engine = "SearXNG" if mode == "simple" else "Vane"
        lines.append(f"## Search Results ({engine})")

        if dt:
            lines.append(
                f"*Search performed on {dt['date']} ({dt['day_name']}) "
                f"at {dt['time']} {dt['timezone']}*"
            )
        lines.append("")

        if not results:
            lines.append("*No results found.*")
            return "\n".join(lines)

        for i, r in enumerate(results, 1):
            title = r.get("title", "Untitled")
            url = r.get("url", "")
            snippet = r.get("snippet", "") or ""
            content = r.get("content")  # full-fetched body

            lines.append(f"### {i}. {title}")
            if url:
                lines.append(f"**Source:** {url}")

            if content:
                # Full content (truncated)
                body = content[:3000]
                if len(content) > 3000:
                    body += "... (truncated)"
                lines.append("")
                lines.append(body)
            elif snippet:
                lines.append("")
                lines.append(snippet)

            lines.append("")
            lines.append("---")
            lines.append("")

        # Append fetch analysis if present
        if fetch_analysis and fetch_analysis.get("needs_full_fetch"):
            lines.append(
                f"*📊 Content quality: {fetch_analysis.get('reason', 'unknown')} "
                f"(confidence: {fetch_analysis.get('confidence', 0):.0%})*"
            )

        return "\n".join(lines)

    # ====================================================================
    # SIMPLE SEARCH (SearXNG)
    # ====================================================================

    async def _simple_search(
        self,
        query: str,
        sources: List[str],
        reasoning: Dict[str, Any],
        dt: Dict[str, str],
        user_valves: Any,
        emitter: Optional[callable] = None,
    ) -> str:
        """Search via SearXNG with optional full-page content extraction.

        Args:
            query: The search query (may include date injection).
            sources: Source list (unused by SearXNG — reserved for signature
                consistency with _deep_search).
            reasoning: Query analysis dict with recency/complexity info.
            dt: Current datetime info.
            user_valves: Resolved UserValves instance.
            emitter: __event_emitter__ callable.

        Returns formatted markdown string.
        """
        url = self._get_config("SEARXNG_URL")
        full_fetch_enabled = self._get_config("full_fetch", user_valves)
        max_full = self._get_config("full_fetch_results", user_valves)
        max_res = self._get_config("max_results", user_valves)
        show_reasoning = self._get_config("show_reasoning", user_valves)

        ua = "Mozilla/5.0 (Windows NT 10.0; Win64; x64) AppleWebKit/537.36"

        if emitter:
            await emitter({
                "type": "status",
                "data": {"description": f"🔍 Searching SearXNG for: {query}", "done": False},
            })

        # ---- Perform search ----
        try:
            resp = await self._request_with_retry(
                "GET",
                f"{url}/search",
                params={"q": query, "format": "json"},
                headers={"User-Agent": ua},
                timeout=15.0,
            )
            data = resp.json()
            raw = data.get("results", [])
        except httpx.TimeoutException:
            return "**Error:** SearXNG search timed out. Please try again."
        except httpx.HTTPStatusError as e:
            return f"**Error:** SearXNG returned HTTP {e.response.status_code}."
        except Exception as e:
            logger.error("SearXNG search failed: %s", e)
            return f"**Error:** Search failed — {e}"

        if emitter:
            await emitter({
                "type": "status",
                "data": {"description": f"✅ Found {len(raw)} results from SearXNG", "done": False},
            })

        limited = raw[:max_res]
        snippets = [r.get("content", "") for r in limited]

        # ---- Determine if full-fetch is needed ----
        # Force full-fetch when:
        #   1. ALWAYS_FULL_FETCH valve is enabled (user wants maximum content)
        #   2. Query was flagged as recency-needy (LLM training data is outdated)
        #   3. Snippet consistency analysis detects issues (contradictions, uncertainty, etc.)
        always_fetch = self._get_config("always_full_fetch", user_valves)
        recency_fetch = reasoning.get("needs_fresh", False)

        fetch_analysis = {"needs_full_fetch": False, "reason": "Disabled", "confidence": 0.0}
        should_fetch = False

        if full_fetch_enabled:
            force = always_fetch or recency_fetch
            fetch_analysis = self._analyze_snippet_consistency(snippets, query, force_fetch=force)
            should_fetch = fetch_analysis["needs_full_fetch"]

        # ---- Build results ----
        results: List[Dict[str, Any]] = []
        for idx, r in enumerate(limited):
            item = {
                "title": r.get("title", "Untitled"),
                "url": r.get("url", ""),
                "snippet": r.get("content", ""),
                "content": None,
            }
            if should_fetch and idx < max_full and item["url"]:
                if emitter:
                    await emitter({
                        "type": "status",
                        "data": {
                            "description": f"📄 Fetching full content ({idx+1}/{max_full})...",
                            "done": False,
                        },
                    })
                try:
                    fr = await self._request_with_retry(
                        "GET",
                        item["url"],
                        headers={"User-Agent": ua},
                        timeout=8.0,
                    )
                    soup = BeautifulSoup(fr.text, "html.parser")
                    for tag in soup(["script", "style", "nav", "footer", "header"]):
                        tag.decompose()
                    text = " ".join(
                        p.get_text(strip=True) for p in soup.find_all("p")
                    )
                    text = " ".join(text.split())
                    if len(text) > 3000:
                        text = text[:3000] + "..."
                    if text:
                        item["content"] = text
                except Exception as exc:
                    logger.warning("Full-fetch failed for %s: %s", item["url"], exc)
            results.append(item)

        # ---- Emit citations ----
        await self._emit_citations(results, emitter)

        if emitter:
            await emitter({
                "type": "status",
                "data": {"description": "✅ Search complete", "done": True},
            })

        # ---- Build output ----
        parts = []
        if show_reasoning:
            parts.append(self._format_reasoning(reasoning, "simple", dt))
            parts.append("")
        parts.append(self._format_search_results(results, "simple", dt, fetch_analysis))
        return "\n".join(parts)

    # ====================================================================
    # DEEP SEARCH (Vane)
    # ====================================================================

    async def _deep_search(
        self,
        query: str,
        sources: List[str],
        depth: str,
        reasoning: Dict[str, Any],
        dt: Dict[str, str],
        user_valves: Any,
        emitter: Optional[callable] = None,
    ) -> str:
        """Search via Vane AI answering engine.

        Returns formatted markdown string with Vane's synthesized response.
        """
        vane_url = self._get_config("VANE_URL")
        vane_timeout = self._get_config("VANE_TIMEOUT")
        show_reasoning = self._get_config("show_reasoning", user_valves)
        use_stream = self._get_config("vane_stream", user_valves)
        sys_instructions = self._get_config("vane_system_instructions", user_valves)

        chat_pid = self.valves.VANE_CHAT_MODEL_PROVIDER_ID
        chat_key = self.valves.VANE_CHAT_MODEL_KEY
        embed_pid = self.valves.VANE_EMBEDDING_MODEL_PROVIDER_ID
        embed_key = self.valves.VANE_EMBEDDING_MODEL_KEY

        if not chat_pid or not embed_pid:
            return (
                "**Error:** Vane is not configured. "
                "Set `VANE_CHAT_MODEL_PROVIDER_ID` and `VANE_EMBEDDING_MODEL_PROVIDER_ID` "
                "in Admin Panel > Functions > ⚙️."
            )

        if emitter:
            await emitter({
                "type": "status",
                "data": {"description": f"🧠 Deep search via Vane for: {query}", "done": False},
            })

        vane_sources = self._map_vane_sources(sources)
        opt_mode = self._map_optimization(depth)

        payload: Dict[str, Any] = {
            "query": query,
            "sources": vane_sources,
            "optimizationMode": opt_mode,
            "stream": bool(use_stream),
            "chatModel": {"providerId": chat_pid, "key": chat_key},
            "embeddingModel": {"providerId": embed_pid, "key": embed_key},
        }

        # Optional Vane features
        if sys_instructions:
            payload["systemInstructions"] = sys_instructions

        if emitter:
            await emitter({
                "type": "status",
                "data": {
                    "description": f"⚙️ Mode: {opt_mode} | Sources: {vane_sources}",
                    "done": False,
                },
            })

        # ---- Request ----
        try:
            resp = await self._request_with_retry(
                "POST",
                f"{vane_url}/api/search",
                json_data=payload,
                headers={"Content-Type": "application/json"},
                timeout=float(vane_timeout),
            )
            data = resp.json()
        except httpx.TimeoutException:
            return "**Error:** Vane deep search timed out. Try again or switch to simple mode."
        except httpx.HTTPStatusError as e:
            return f"**Error:** Vane returned HTTP {e.response.status_code}."
        except Exception as e:
            logger.error("Vane search failed: %s", e)
            return f"**Error:** Vane search failed — {e}"

        message = data.get("message", "")
        vane_sources_data = data.get("sources", [])

        if emitter:
            await emitter({
                "type": "status",
                "data": {
                    "description": f"✅ Vane synthesized response ({len(vane_sources_data)} sources)",
                    "done": False,
                },
            })

        # ---- Build result list ----
        results: List[Dict[str, Any]] = []
        for s in vane_sources_data:
            meta = s.get("metadata", {})
            results.append({
                "title": meta.get("title", "Untitled"),
                "url": meta.get("url", ""),
                "snippet": (s.get("content", "") or "")[:500],
                "content": s.get("content", ""),
            })

        # ---- Emit citations ----
        await self._emit_citations(results, emitter)

        if emitter:
            await emitter({
                "type": "status",
                "data": {"description": "✅ Deep search complete", "done": True},
            })

        # ---- Build output ----
        parts = []
        if show_reasoning:
            parts.append(self._format_reasoning(reasoning, "deep", dt))
            parts.append("")

        parts.append(f"## 🔬 Deep Search Results (Vane · {opt_mode} mode)")
        if dt:
            parts.append(
                f"*Search performed on {dt['date']} ({dt['day_name']}) "
                f"at {dt['time']} {dt['timezone']}*"
            )
        parts.append("")

        if message:
            parts.append("### Synthesized Answer")
            parts.append("")
            parts.append(message)
            parts.append("")

        if results:
            parts.append("### Sources")
            parts.append("")
            for i, r in enumerate(results, 1):
                parts.append(
                    f"{i}. **[{r['title']}]({r['url']})**  \n"
                    f"   {r['snippet'][:300]}"
                )
            parts.append("")

        return "\n".join(parts)

    # ====================================================================
    # MAIN ENTRY POINT
    # ====================================================================

    async def optimized_search(
        self,
        query: str,
        __event_emitter__: Optional[callable] = None,
        __user__: Optional[dict] = None,
        __metadata__: Optional[dict] = None,
    ) -> str:
        """Search the web for current, accurate information. ALWAYS use this for web searches instead of search_web.

        This is the primary web search function — it provides comprehensive results
        that the built-in search_web cannot match:
        - Detects when queries need fresh data (post-2023 topics, breaking news, "just announced")
        - Injects the current date/time into searches for temporal accuracy
        - Auto-selects SearXNG (fast, 3-8s) or Vane (AI-synthesized, 15-60s) based on query complexity
        - Fetches full page content when snippets are insufficient or outdated
        - Provides clickable source citations in the chat interface

        Args:
            query: The search query — can be a question or keywords.
            __event_emitter__: System event emitter (injected automatically).
            __user__: Current user info (injected automatically).
            __metadata__: Chat metadata (injected automatically).

        Returns:
            Formatted markdown with search results, sources, and reasoning.
        """
        emitter = __event_emitter__
        user_valves: Optional[Tools.UserValves] = None
        if __user__ and isinstance(__user__.get("valves"), Tools.UserValves):
            user_valves = __user__["valves"]

        # --- Resolve config ---
        mode = self._get_config("mode", user_valves)
        sources_str = self._get_config("sources", user_valves)
        show_reasoning = self._get_config("show_reasoning", user_valves)
        max_results = self._get_config("max_results", user_valves)
        sources_list = self._parse_sources(sources_str)

        # --- Recency detection (organically, no valve needed) ---
        needs_fresh, fresh_reason, fresh_conf = self._detect_recency_need(query)

        # --- Date/time injection: always inject for recency queries ---
        enriched_query, dt = self._inject_datetime(query, force_inject=needs_fresh)

        # --- Analyze query ---
        if mode == "auto":
            reasoning = self._analyze_query_complexity(query)
            reasoning["mode_requested"] = "auto"
            reasoning["selection_type"] = "automatic"
            reasoning["user_settings"] = {
                "mode": mode,
                "sources": sources_str,
                "max_results": max_results,
                "show_reasoning": show_reasoning,
            }
            selected_mode = reasoning["decision"]
        else:
            reasoning = {
                "query": query,
                "mode_requested": mode,
                "mode_selected": mode,
                "selection_type": "manual",
                "triggers": [],
                "trigger_count": 0,
                "token_count": len(query.split()),
                "is_temporal": self._is_temporal_query(query),
                "needs_fresh": needs_fresh,
                "fresh_reason": fresh_reason,
                "fresh_confidence": fresh_conf,
                "decision": mode,
                "user_settings": {
                    "mode": mode,
                    "sources": sources_str,
                    "max_results": max_results,
                    "show_reasoning": show_reasoning,
                },
            }
            selected_mode = mode

        # --- Vane gating: if Vane is disabled, force fallback ---
        vane_enabled = self._get_config("enable_vane", user_valves)
        if selected_mode == "deep" and not vane_enabled:
            if mode == "auto":
                # Auto mode: silently fall through to simple
                reasoning["vane_disabled_fallback"] = True
                reasoning["decision"] = "simple"
                selected_mode = "simple"
                if emitter:
                    await emitter({
                        "type": "status",
                        "data": {
                            "description": "ℹ️ Vane is disabled — falling back to SearXNG simple search",
                            "done": False,
                        },
                    })
            else:
                # Manual mode: user explicitly chose deep — tell them to enable Vane
                return (
                    "**Vane deep search is currently disabled.**\n\n"
                    "To use deep search, enable Vane in your chat settings:\n"
                    "- Open the tool settings (⚙️ in chat)\n"
                    "- Set **Enable Vane** to **On**\n\n"
                    "Or switch your search mode to **simple** for SearXNG search.\n\n"
                    "> 💡 **Tip:** SearXNG with full-fetch provides comprehensive results "
                    "in 3-8 seconds — your LLM can synthesize the answer from raw sources "
                    "just as effectively for most queries."
                )

        # --- Emit status ---
        if emitter:
            temporal_tag = " 📅" if reasoning.get("is_temporal") else ""
            vane_tag = "" if vane_enabled else " (Vane off)"
            await emitter({
                "type": "status",
                "data": {
                    "description": (
                        f"🎯 Mode: {selected_mode.upper()} "
                        f"({reasoning.get('trigger_count', 0)} triggers)"
                        f"{temporal_tag}{vane_tag}"
                    ),
                    "done": False,
                },
            })

        # --- Use enriched query for temporal or recency-needy searches ---
        search_query = (
            enriched_query
            if reasoning.get("is_temporal") or reasoning.get("needs_fresh")
            else query
        )

        # --- Dispatch ---
        if selected_mode == "simple":
            return await self._simple_search(
                search_query, sources_list, reasoning, dt, user_valves, emitter
            )
        elif selected_mode == "deep":
            return await self._deep_search(
                search_query,
                sources_list,
                "balanced",
                reasoning,
                dt,
                user_valves,
                emitter,
            )
        else:
            return f"**Error:** Invalid mode '{mode}'. Use 'auto', 'simple', or 'deep'."
